page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m4.large is an entry-level burstable instance driven by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor based on x86_64 architecture. It provides 2 vCPUs across 1 physical CPU core with hyperthreading (2 threads per core) alongside 8.0 GB of memory. The instance features hardware support for instruction set extensions including AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, and AES encryption. It runs under KVM virtualization and includes no bundled local storage or discrete GPU accelerators.

Benchmark evaluations position the compute and memory capability of this instance in lower performance brackets. The instance scored 1161.28 in stress-ng single-core tests and 2371.48 in multi-core tests, placing it in weak and poor performance categories respectively. Memory bandwidth tests yielded 22.38 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 19.14 GB/sec for writes. PassMark CPU testing yielded a score of 3062.61, while static web serving throughput reached 2.58 GB/sec and Redis SET performance averaged 2.61 million operations per second.

Featuring a burstable CPU allocation and low baseline resource thresholds, this instance type prioritizes cost efficiency for light, non-sustained computing workloads rather than high continuous throughput. The principal tradeoff is restricted multi-core compute capability and limited memory bandwidth under sustained processing demands. Consequently, the ecs.t6-c1m4.large server is structured for lightweight web applications, low-traffic development or test environments, basic background tasks, and minor administrative utilities.
